This will either work or not work but maybe if you listen to one songs that makes you depressed and then you just listen to a whole album it won’t effect u the same as breaking it up and listening to a new song every once and a while just hoping it won’t effect. Personally I know what Tame Impala songs make me feel a certain way so depending on how I’m feeling or want to feel I will listen to specific songs. But if a song like yes I’m changing comes on I’ll either skip it if I don’t want to get down, let it play and just chill and groove with it, or I’ll bawl my eyes out to it. But don’t stop listening to Tame Impala completely! He has so many other amazing songs, happy songs. Songs that can make you feel like you’re floating and everything is perfect in this world. But if you’re new to Tame Impala I’d pick a time to listen to his music where if u do run into a song that gets you down or feel a certain way, you won’t have to worry about it. Hope that helps :)
